powergain.desc: Card base power grows by 1.11 for each card in the row (excluding itself). Card base power is not affected by weather, but its bonus power is reduced by 75% under weather effects. Values are rounded down.

axii.desc: Each card in row under Axii effect that base power is less than 5 will lose 2 power. Debuffs dont stack. Dont affect hero cards

turn_skipper_conf.desc: Let you skip turns, but gives your opponent 50/50 each skip to copy non-hero card from board. You need 1 charge to skip turn, you get 0.35 charges per your turn, up to 2 max charge(s) stored!

d20cloner.desc: Let you roll D20 for chance to get additional card from board, but what card you can get depends on roll result. Success on even roll. You need 1 charge to roll dice, you get 0.16 charges per your turn, up to 1 max charge(s) stored!

map_results_txt._op_lambert:

DontPickMeUp.description: Card cannot be picked up after being placed.

clear.name: Clear Weather
clear.description: Removes all Weather Cards (Biting Frost, Impenetrable Fog and Torrential Rain) effects.

frost.name: Biting Frost
frost.description: Sets the strength of all Close Combat cards to 1 for both players.

fog.name: Impenetrable Fog
fog.description: Sets the strength of all Ranged Combat cards to 1 for both players.

rain.name: Torrential Rain
rain.description: Sets the strength of all Siege Combat cards to 1 for both players.

storm.name: Skellige Storm
storm.description: Reduces the Strength of all Range and Siege Units to 1.

hero.name: Hero Card
hero.description: Not affected by any Special Cards or abilities.

decoy.name: Decoy
decoy.description: Swap with a card on the battlefield to return it to your hand.

wshield.name: Shield
wshield.description: Partialy protects all cards in same row from weather card effects and axii, Commander's Horn will have no effect in that row.

yrden.name: Witcher Signs: Yrden
yrden.description: Witchers Magic Trap, place on enemy ranged row to aplly -1 to each unit card. Effects stacks. Decoy can be used to pick up the card!

horn.name: Commander's Horn
horn.description: Doubles the strength of all unit cards in that row. Limited to 1 per row.

darkstormegen.name: Darkness Storm
darkstormegen.description: Darkness rages around this card! All non-hero card around in same row will be destroyed!

mardroeme.name: Mardroeme
mardroeme.description: Triggers transformation of all Berserker cards on the same row.

berserker.name: Berserker
berserker.description: Transforms into a bear when a Mardroeme card is on its row.

scorch.name: Scorch
scorch.description: Discard after playing. Kills the strongest card(s) on the battlefield.

scorch_c.name: Scorch - Close Combat
scorch_c.description: Destroy your enemy's strongest Close Combat unit(s) if the combined strength of all his or her Close Combat units is 10 or more.

scorch_r.name: Scorch - Ranged
scorch_r.description: Destroy your enemy's strongest Ranged Combat unit(s) if the combined strength of all his or her Ranged Combat units is 10 or more.

scorch_s.name: Scorch - Siege
scorch_s.description: Destroy your enemy's strongest Siege Combat unit(s) if the combined strength of all his or her Siege Combat units is 10 or more.

scorch_a.name: Scorch - Agilie
scorch_a.description: Destroy your enemy's strongest opposite row Combat unit(s) if the combined strength of all his or her opposite row Combat units is 10 or more.

scorchstopper.description: Prevents Scorch effects by spending 1 Shield Charge per saved card. Starts with 5 charges, cannot be recharged, and breaks if you play any Scorch card.

agile.name: agile
agile.description: Can be placed in either the Close Combat or the Ranged Combat row. Cannot be moved once placed.

muster.name: muster
muster.description: Find any cards with the same name in your deck and play them instantly.

spy.name: spy
spy.description: Place on your opponent's battlefield (counts towards your opponent's total) and draw 2 cards from your deck.

sabotage.name: sabotage
sabotage.description: Send to enemy fields this cards to lower their score and draw extra 1 card(s).

resilience.name: Resilience
resilience.description: Remains on the board for the following round.

resilience_igni.name: Witcher Signs: Ignii
resilience_igni.description: Remains on the board for the following round. Adds +1 to all units in the row (excluding itself). Effects dont stacks

aard.name: Witcher Signs: Aard
aard.description: Push all enemy units in the opposing row one row back toward Siege, ignoring shields. Playing this card will damage your total score! Hero and few other cards will ignore push (Internal Game Desing).

aid.name: Call to Arms
aid.description: Lets you and your opponent redraw 5 cards.

axii.name: Witcher Signs
axii.description: This card use Witchers tricks to cast into enemy fields Axii sign. Each card in row under Axii effect that base power is less than 5 will lose 2 power. Debuffs dont stack. Dont affect hero cards.

axii2_desc.name: Axii
axii2_desc.description: Each card in row under Axii effect that base power is less than 5 will lose 2 power. Debuffs dont stack. Dont affect hero cards

axii2_desc_playable.name: Witcher Signs: Axii
axii2_desc_playable.description: Each card in row under Axii effect that base power is less than 5 will lose 2 power. Debuffs dont stack. Dont affect hero cards

gryffinSchool.name: Griffin School
gryffinSchool.description: Choose one Witcher Sign card and add it to your hand. The card cannot be picked up with the Decoy once it has been placed!

magicthegathering.name: Conjunction of the Spheres
magicthegathering.description: Choose one card out of 25 random and add it to your hand. The card cannot be picked up with the Decoy once it has been placed! This card is unstable, each turn it power will change in most of the time negative numbers (On averge power will be -3.27)

tgc_portal.name: That Game Company
tgc_portal.description: Choose one card out of max 25 Sky Faction cards and add it to your hand. The card cannot be picked up with the Decoy once it has been placed! This card is unstable, each turn it power will change in most of the time negative numbers (On averge power will be -3.27)

dopler.name: Doppler
dopler.description: Send a shapeshifter to enemy fields that will will disguise itself as a strong card from the opponent's faction, so next round they can find a knife in their back

reinforce.name: Reinforce
reinforce.description: Summons additional cards to board, summoned cards dont need to be in hand or deck.

medic.name: medic
medic.description: Choose one card from your discard pile and play it instantly (no Heroes or Special Cards).

medic_n.name: necromancy
medic_n.description: Choose one card from your discard pile and play it instantly (no Heroes or Special Cards).

morale.name: Morale
morale.description: Adds +1 to all units in the row (excluding itself).

powergain.name: Power Gain
powergain.description: Card base power grows by 1.11 for each card in the row (excluding itself). Card base power is not affected by weather, but its bonus power is reduced by 75% under weather effects. Values are rounded down.

bond.name: Tight Bond
bond.description: Place next to a card with the same name to double the strength of both cards.

avenger.name: Avenger
avenger.description: When this card is removed from the battlefield, it summons a powerful new Unit Card to take its place.

dopavenger.name: Doppler
dopavenger.description: When this card is removed from the battlefield, it summons a powerful new Unit Card to take its place.

avenger_kambi.name: Avenger
avenger_kambi.description: When this card is removed from the battlefield, it summons a powerful new Unit Card to take its place.

foltest_king.description: Pick an Impenetrable Fog card from your deck and play it instantly.

keadwen_weather.description: Play an Impenetrable Fog from your deck. If none is found, still consume leader charge. Let you skip turns, but gives your opponent 50/50 each skip to copy non-hero card from board. You need 1 charge to skip turn, you get 0.2 charges per your turn, up to 1 max charge(s) stored!

foltest_lord.description: Clear any weather effects (resulting from Biting Frost, Torrential Rain or Impenetrable Fog cards) in play.

foltest_siegemaster.description: Doubles the strength of all your Siege units (unless a Commander's Horn is also present on that row).

foltest_steelforged.description: Destroy your enemy's strongest Siege unit(s) if the combined strength of all his or her Siege units is 10 or more.

foltest_son.description: Destroy your enemy's strongest Ranged Combat unit(s) if the combined strength of all his or her Ranged Combat units is 10 or more.

emhyr_imperial.description: Pick a Torrential Rain card from your deck and play it instantly.

nilf_drawmaster.description: On use, if your hand has fewer than 3 cards, draw 1 cards from your deck, plus 1 additional card for each unit in your graveyard (up to 3 bonus cards). You start the game with 2 fewer cards in hand but you can on game start redraw extra 1 card(s).

temeria_call.description: Spawn Temeria Special Forcess attack in close combat row. Commander Horn in close combat row will lost its effect but close row will be partialy protected partialy from weather effects. After use makes you pass! Can't be used when opponent passed!

darkness_storm_leader.description: Spawn Darkness Storm on both sides that destroys all non-hero cards in the close row

turn_skiper.description: Let you skip turns, but gives your opponent 50/50 each skip to copy non-hero card from board. You need 1 charge to skip turn, you get 0.35 charges per your turn, up to 2 max charge(s) stored!

d20cloner.description: Let you roll D20 for chance to get additional card from board, but what card you can get depends on roll result. Success on even roll. You need 1 charge to roll dice, you get 0.16 charges per your turn, up to 1 max charge(s) stored!

gaunter_neutral_leader.description: On use both sides will gain an additional (60%+1)  of the number of cards in the thier grave as additional cards from deck and all players start the game with 50% more cards in their hand (based on their starting number)

emhyr_emperor.description: Look at 3 random cards from your opponent's hand.

emhyr_whiteflame2.description: Copy opponents's leader card at start of the game, but your opponent will have addtional 2 initial redraws

emhyr_relentless.description: Draw a card from your opponent's discard pile.

emhyr_invader.description: Medics cannot choose which card to revive and draw the strongest one from the graveyard (affects both players).

eredin_commander.description: Double the strength of all your Close Combat units (unless a Commander's horn is 	also present on that row).

eredin_bringer_of_death.name: Eredin : Bringer of Death
eredin_bringer_of_death.description: Recive a copy of card from your discard pile to your hand.

eredin_destroyer.description: Banish 2 cards from your hand and create a copy of a card from your deck.

eredin_king.description: Pick any weather card from your deck and play it instantly.

eredin_treacherous.description: Doubles the strength of all spy cards (affects both players).

francesca_queen.description: Destroy your enemy's strongest Close Combat unit(s) if the combined strength of all his or her Close Combat units is 10 or more.

francesca_beautiful.description: Doubles the strength of all your Ranged Combat units (unless a Commander's Horn is also present on that row).

francesca_daisy.description: Draw an extra card at the beginning of the battle.

francesca_pureblood.description: Pick a Biting Frost card from your deck and play it instantly.

francesca_hope.description: Move agile units to whichever valid row maximizes their strength (don't move units already in optimal row).

mediclove.description: Both players can revive extra card when using medic card ability.

crach_an_craite.description: Shuffle all cards from each player's graveyard back into their decks.

king_bran.description: Units only lose half their Strength in bad weather conditions.

eist_tuirseach.description: Pick a Skellige Storm card from your deck and play it instantly.

skellige_berserk_reward.description: Spawn a Mardroeme card in the row with the most Berserkers.

skellige_bond_summoner.description: Banish a card with power greater than or equal to 4. Then create a Tight Bond card from your faction or Neutral and add it to your hand.

nilfgaard.description: Wins any round that ends in a draw.

skellige.description: The strongest 2 cards from the graveyard are placed on the battlefield at the start of the third round. Revived cards lose most abilities.

syndicate.description:
Starts the game with the morale card on the board. 
Can create deck from Nilfgaardian Empire, Scoia'tael, Skellige, Syndicate, Sky Kingdom factions non-leader cards.

sky.name: Sky Kingdom
sky.description: Keeps the strongest Unit Card out after each round. Factions full of morale boosting cards.
